entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu al-Nu'man Bashir ibn Sa'd al-Ansari was a prominent companion (Sahaba) of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and a leader of the Banu Khazraj tribe in Medina. A veteran of the Battle of Badr, Bashir was among the early converts from the Ansar and was one of the few individuals of his era literate in Arabic.
